title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This typescript page (numbered '- 23 -') is unrelated to the motivic Galois material on the neighbouring manuscript pages. It is part of a standard proof of the existence theorem for analytic ordinary differential equations depending analytically on parameters, over a complete valued field K, by the method of power series and majorants.

The problem is to find analytic u_1,...,u_p of (x; z_1,...,z_q) such that:
- (12) D u_i = f_i(x; u_1,...,u_p; z), where D = d/dx;
- (13) u_i(a; z) = b_i for all z in a polycylinder W.

By translation one reduces to a = b_j = c_k = 0. Each f_i is then the sum of a convergent ('sommable') power series on a polydisc B×P×Q, given by (14):
f_i = Σ g_i(n; r; λ) x^n y^r z^λ.

One seeks power series u_i = Σ h_i(m; μ) x^m z^μ with no x-independent term, convergent on U×W and substitutable into (14). Identifying coefficients of x^{m-1} z^μ on both sides of (12) gives the recursion (15):
- h_i(0; μ) = 0;
- m h_i(m; μ) = Σ g_i(n; r; λ) ∏_j ∏_{k=1}^{r_j} h_j(s_{kj}; ν_{kj·}).

The sum runs over the index systems with n + Σ s_{kj} = m − 1 and λ_ℓ + Σ ν_{kjℓ} = μ_ℓ; these conditions are stated on the following typed page. Since every s_{kj} < m, the recursion determines the h uniquely. Convergence is then proved by comparison with a majorant system, the Cauchy majorant method. This is textbook material of the Bourbaki/Dieudonné/Serre (Lie Algebras and Lie Groups) type.
errors: Inside the product in (15) the coefficient should be h_j (the j-th unknown, raised to the power r_j), not h_i. As typed, h_i is a typo or a slip of indexing.
The summation conditions (n + Σ_{j,k} s_{kj} = m−1, λ_ℓ + Σ ν_{kjℓ} = μ_ℓ) are deferred to the next page. They are not stated on this page, so this is not a gap.

ideas.what: Existence of analytic solutions of ODEs with analytic parameters over a complete valued field via formal power series recursion and convergence
ideas.modern_name: Cauchy existence theorem for analytic ODEs (method of majorants), over arbitrary complete valued fields
ideas.usually_credited_to: Cauchy; for general valued fields, standard (Bourbaki, Serre's Lie Algebras and Lie Groups, Dieudonné)
ideas.where_published: Standard textbooks (e.g. Bourbaki Variétés différentielles et analytiques, Serre LALG)

deep.surprise_reason: A routine typescript page on the classical power-series proof of the analytic Cauchy theorem with parameters. It appears to be a stray sheet unrelated to the motivic and Galois manuscript around it, and contains nothing new.
transcription_corrections: In (15) the factor in the double product should mathematically read h_j(s_{kj}; ν_{kj1},...,ν_{kjq}). The typescript appears to have h_i.
'polydylindre' in the typescript is a typo for 'polycylindre'.
The marginal '44' at bottom left is the archive page number, not part of the text.
